# Golden IFC corpus

Round-trip fixtures for `scripts/golden-roundtrip.mjs` (CI workflow
`.github/workflows/golden-roundtrip.yml`). The harness parses every `*.ifc`
file in this folder twice, diffs entity-class counts, and compares the result
against the golden snapshot in `snapshots/<file>.ifc.json`. A mismatch fails CI.

## Current state (2026-11-13)

The corpus now contains **3 self-authored fixtures** generated by `scripts/generate-ifc.mjs`
(env-parametrized: SCHEMA / OUT / PROJ / MODEL / LEVELS), so the gate runs for real:

| Fixture | Schema | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `generated-small.ifc` | IFC4 | 2 walls + 1 door (hosted opening) + 1 slab |
| `generated-2x3.ifc` | IFC2X3 | same model, IFC2X3 schema |
| `generated-structural.ifc` | IFC4 | 1 beam + 1 column |

All fixtures are generated from the platform's own authoring writer — no third-party
license constraints. `node scripts/golden-roundtrip.mjs` must report `3/3 pass`.
To grow the corpus toward the 20-fixture goal (P1-03), add more MODEL variants and
commit `.ifc` + `snapshots/<name>.ifc.json` together.
